ground_connection.routing: C82.2 is PGND. R113 pin 2 (PGND) lands on the C82.2 pad copper with 3-4 PGND vias to In1 at C82.2 (TI SLVSGT7 8.4.1 items 6/7). AGND_U2 is a trace-only island (U2.17/.5, R9.2, R110.2, C83.2, TP28) fed ONLY from R113 pin 1: F.Cu traces, plus at most one AGND_U2 via pair and one B.Cu AGND_U2 trace (<= 0.25 mm, over solid In1, not under L1 or the SW nodes) where the U2 power fan-out separates the north members (U2.17, R113.1, C83.2, R9.2, TP28) from the south-east members (U2.5, R110.2). No AGND pour on any layer, no AGND_U2 via or copper touching In1/In2/B.Cu GND, no second 0 ohm, no net tie. In1 stays solid PGND under the island. The checker fails any AGND_U2 copper touching GND other than through R113.

kelvin.rule: Sense traces leave pads 2/3 on their +y edge within 0.6 mm of the inner (element) end, run as a 0.2 mm coupled pair (<= 0.3 mm gap; only the last <= 2 mm at U2 follow the pin escape) on F.Cu to U2 pins 12/13, never touch force copper, P12_VOUT or +12V pours, and carry no current. TP22/TP23 branch from the pair after it leaves the pads. Force current enters/leaves only through pads 1/4. Sense pads stay free of pour (keep-out 0.3 mm).

D10.model: SS1060 at 0.75 V x 3 A = 2.25 W; needs effective RthetaJA <= 33 C/W for Tj <= 125 C at 50 C ambient

requirements.copper: VPD (anode) and MAIN_IN (cathode) F.Cu pours >= 400 mm2 each, each with >= 8 vias to a same-net B.Cu area >= 300 mm2

R109.model: TA-I RLM12: 1 W at 70 C with 300 mm2 of pad + trace copper; derates to 0 at 155 C

requirements.force_copper: P12_VOUT (pad 1) and +12V (pad 4) F.Cu copper >= 150 mm2 each within 10 mm (>= 300 mm2 together), each with >= 3 vias to a same-net B.Cu or In2 area

U2.model: TI SLVSGT7 6.4 RthetaJA 43.4 C/W (JEDEC 2s2p); EVM 27.5 C/W (4-layer 2/1/1/2 oz 91 x 66 mm)

requirements.B_Cu_GND: B.Cu GND pour >= 600 mm2 under the U2 / L1 / bank region, stitched to In1 with >= 20 vias
requirements.In1: solid PGND plane (0.5 oz), no slot or cut within 15 mm of the U2 centre (via antipads only)
requirements.PGND_vias: >= 10 vias 0.3/0.6 mm with centres <= 4 mm outside the package outline on the PGND copper of the U2 cell: at both PGND land ends where the fan-out leaves room (the bars are on a 0.5 mm pitch: SW1/SW2 leave west, VIN/VOUT east), at C8.2 and C81.2 and on the PGND copper joining them; to In1 and to the B.Cu GND pour; never in a pad
requirements.VIN_area: F.Cu VIN pour >= 120 mm2 joining U2 pin 7, C8, C6, C7, C77, C78 and D24 K; >= 6 vias to an In2 VIN area >= 300 mm2
requirements.VOUT_area: F.Cu P12_VOUT pour >= 150 mm2 joining U2 pin 11, C81, C11-C14, C79, C80 and R109 pad 1; >= 6 vias to a B.Cu P12_VOUT area >= 200 mm2. D26 K and TP20 (no DC current) join it with >= 1.0 mm copper or >= 2 vias from the B.Cu area, never through +12V copper

U4.model: LMR38020 DDA exposed pad = -12V (IC ground), not GND

requirements.copper: footprint thermal vias to a -12V area >= 300 mm2 on In2 or B.Cu; no GND on the EP

U5.model: TPS16630 PWP exposed pad = GND; <= 0.48 W at 3 A (53 mOhm max)

requirements.copper: footprint thermal vias to In1 GND
